items.physical_scope: This is a conditional calculation for a specified Euclidean massless left-handed SU(2) fundamental-fermion determinant/Pfaffian family on S^4, one fixed index-one background, its order-two central transformation, and the stated mod-two-index bulk response. It does not construct an interacting continuum theory, classify every anomaly loop, or infer that even copies have no other anomalies.

items.physical_scope: This worked example uses one specified Euclidean SU(2) Weyl-doublet determinant family, the explicit odd-index hypothesis, the central order-two test, and its mod-two-index bulk response. The finite BC2 calculation is a normalization check, not a continuum discretization or a general anomaly classification.
